results.L_Remarks: Former model home. Elevated design. Exceptional indoor-outdoor living. Private backyard with no rear neighbors. Set within the Tamarack neighborhood of Spencer’s Crossing, this distinctive residence pairs designer finishes & extensive upgrades w/a flexible floor plan. Step through the dramatic entry, where custom woodwork & striking black-and-white chandeliers establish the home’s sophisticated design aesthetic. The main level includes a bedroom & an office/den, with the versatile office/den easily adaptable as a second bedroom—ideal for guests, extended family, or added privacy. At the heart of the home, the open-concept great room, dining area & gourmet kitchen creates a natural gathering space. The kitchen features warm greige shaker cabinetry, an oversized quartz waterfall island, stainless steel appliances, double ovens, a 5-burner gas cooktop, farmhouse sink, & large walk-in pantry. An elegant, illuminated glass-enclosed wine room adds a memorable architectural detail just off the dining area. 90-Degree Multi-Slide doors open up the corner and sides of the great room for uninterrupted indoor/outdoor living. The covered CA room opens to a brick patio, while the pool-sized backyard is framed by a block wall and vinyl fencing w/ no rear neighbors, enhancing privacy. Extensive turf, a separate concrete dining area illuminated by string lights, an outdoor BBQ island & a tucked-away gas fire pit w/ seating area create multiple spaces for outdoor enjoyment. Mature fruit trees add seasonal color & garden-to-table enjoyment. A separate AlumaWood covered patio currently serves as a dedicated workout space. The primary suite offers a private retreat w/a spacious bathroom featuring dual sinks, a soaking tub & an oversized walk-in shower, complemented by a walk-in closet. Throughout the home, warm greige cabinetry, upgraded flooring, custom shiplap, designer paint & upgraded lighting create a cohesive aesthetic. Thoughtfully designed for the rhythms of daily living, the home offers both an upstairs laundry room & a dedicated downstairs laundry/mud room complete w/ a pet-washing station & grooming area. Energy, comfort & convenience upgrades include fully pre-paid solar lease, dual A/C, QuietCool whole-house fan, tankless water heater & extensive recessed LED lighting. Spencer’s Crossing residents enjoy an array of community amenities, including multiple pools and spas, parks, playgrounds, clubhouse facilities, walking trails, BBQ areas, fire pits & more.

results.remarks: PRICE REDUCTION POOL HOME. The formal living room and dining room are an entertainer's dream. The Spacious primary bedroom features a large retreat, plantation shutters on the windows and sliding door open to the balcony. The primary bath has dual sinks, a beautiful tub, shower, toilet with door, his and her walk in closets.  This home is located within the Murrieta Valley Unified School District and quick access to both the 15 & 215 Freeways, shopping, restaurant and Temecula wineries. The property will be sold in its current "AS-IS" condition without any repair, termite, warranties or representations. results.remarks: SPACE, & RESORT-STYLE LIVING IN WEST MURRIETA! Welcome HOME to this exceptional 5-bedroom, 3-bathroom home in the highly sought-after West Murrieta! This home offers newer paint at interior & exterior, & HUGE BEDROOMS! RARE attached 4-car garage, pre-paid solar through 2033, no HOA, low taxes, & an incredible private backyard oasis w/pool, spa & outdoor kitchen!  This home certainly checks all of the boxes for Southern California living at its finest. From the moment you enter, you are greeted by a dramatic curved staircase, soaring 20-foot ceilings, beautiful tile flooring & plantation shutters, creating an impressive & welcoming first impression. The main level features a bedroom & full bathroom, making it ideal for guests, a home office, or multigenerational living. The laundry is also on the main level & offers an abundance of cabinetry, a deep soaking sink & closet for ample storage.  The recently remodeled kitchen offers a spacious open-concept featuring quartz countertops, gorgeous self-closing cabinetry w/dovetail construction, lazy Susan, pots/pans drawer & soft close drawers. The kitchen also offers built in stainless double ovens, built in stainless microwave, & a gas range top w/stainless hood.  Enjoy breakfasts or entertaining guests on the spacious center island.  The eat in kitchen offers a generous space that opens directly to the large family room, where a cozy fireplace & surround sound create the perfect atmosphere for relaxing with family or friends. The formal front living and dining room offer volume ceilings, neutral wood look flooring and space for a large dining set. The second level features 4 additional and generously sized bedrooms, a full bathroom, and a wide landing that provides an open, comfortable flow throughout the second level. The spacious primary suite offers a private retreat with gorgeous tree top views & ensuite bathroom with an enormous walk-in closet. Additional 2nd floor features include Corian bathroom countertops & a QuietCool whole-house fan system for added comfort. The outside is an entertainer's paradise with a sparkling pool and spa to provide the perfect setting for summer fun and relaxation. The impressive outdoor kitchen features a built-in BBQ, space for a small refrigerator, a sink and a generous concrete counter space for outdoor cooking. What more could you ask for! If you need space, love to entertain, and want the best of West Murrieta living, this is the home you've been waiting for - RUN!

results.remarks: WEST MURRIETA POOL HOME | PAID-OFF SOLAR | NO HOA | MVUSD | MAIN-LEVEL BEDROOM & FULL BATH! Just off the entry, a private main-level bedroom with ADA-compliant widened doorways and a full bath provides added accessibility and flexibility. Wide-plank wood-look flooring extends through the main level, leading past the formal dining area and into the open living spaces. Crown molding and recessed lighting complement the updated interior. The family room is anchored by an elegant fireplace with a substantial wood mantel and built-ins, flowing naturally into the kitchen and dining areas. Sliding doors extend the open-concept living space into a true entertainer’s backyard. A spacious covered patio opens to a terraced setting with multiple seating and gathering areas overlooking a PebbleTec pool with stone waterfall, mature palms, and established landscaping. A built-in BBQ and a separate outdoor dining area provide dedicated spaces for entertaining, while the wide side yard offers potential RV parking. Upstairs, the wide-plank flooring continues into a large loft with flexible space for a media room, game room, home office, or secondary living area. The spacious primary suite features crown molding and an ensuite bath with dual sinks, soaking tub, and a separate shower; additional bedrooms complete the upper level. Paid-off solar and no HOA add to the appeal of this West Murrieta home, which is within the Murrieta Valley Unified School District and near Old Town Murrieta, parks, shopping, dining, and convenient I-15 and I-215 access.

results.remarks: Set on a quiet cul-de-sac with NO HOA, this home combines comfort and practicality with resort-style living. Inside, you’ll find flexible spaces including a downstairs bedroom and bath, a spacious loft, and a retreat off the primary suite — perfect for work, play, or relaxation. A large kitchen island anchors the living areas, enhanced by recessed LED lighting, a 40-panel solar system, and a whole-house water filtration system. The real showpiece is the backyard. An insulated patio cover with ceiling fans keeps gatherings cool, while the built-in outdoor kitchen — complete with BBQ, sink, refrigerator, warming plate, and kegerator — is built for entertaining. The sparkling pebble-tech pool and spa, framed by a dramatic rock waterfall, transform the space into a private oasis where every day feels like a getaway. *

results.remarks: Welcome to this spacious Murrieta pool home, designed with family living, entertaining, and flexibility in mind! With 5 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms and a 3 car garage, there’s plenty of room for everyone to spread out. A full bedroom and bathroom downstairs is perfect for guests, extended family, a home office, or playroom, while the primary suite and three additional bedrooms are all located upstairs.  The heart of the home offers generous living and entertaining spaces along with a generous size kitchen featuring plenty of cabinetry and room to gather. Upstairs, the oversized primary suite takes things to another level with an ADDITIONAL bonus space offering so many possibilities. Create your dream home gym, private office, movie theater, nursery, or quiet retreat—the space is there to make it your own.  But the backyard may just steal the show! The lagoon-style pool and spa create your own private escape, with plenty of space surrounding the pool for kids to play, outdoor dining, lounging, and entertaining family and friends. Tropical landscaping adds to the resort-like feel and makes this a backyard you'll want to enjoy all year long.  Ideally located in Murrieta’s Golden Triangle between the 15 and 215 freeways, this home puts you close to shopping, dining, entertainment, parks, and highly rated Murrieta schools. With space to grow, room to entertain, and a backyard built for making memories, this is the kind of home a family can truly settle into and enjoy for years to come.

results.remarks: Nestled within the exclusive guard-gated community of Greer Ranch, this stunning pool home offers luxury living on a premier view lot with breathtaking panoramic vistas. Tucked away on a quiet street, this spacious single-story home features nearly 3,200 square feet of beautifully upgraded living space, including a newly built custom pool and spa designed to maximize the incredible views. The thoughtfully designed floor plan showcases a grand entry with vaulted ceilings, formal living and dining areas, and an expansive family room with a cozy fireplace and large picture windows that frame the surrounding scenery. The chef’s kitchen is the heart of the home, featuring an oversized quartz island with matching countertops, stainless steel appliances, and upgraded wood-look laminate flooring throughout. The spacious primary suite offers a private retreat with sunset views, a large walk-in closet, dual vanities, a soaking jacuzzi tub, and an oversized shower. Three additional bedrooms are conveniently located on the main level. Upstairs, a generous loft provides the perfect flex space for a home office, game room, media room, or potential fifth bedroom, complete with a private balcony overlooking the endless views. Step outside to your own private resort-style backyard, featuring a custom newly built Pebble Tec pool and spa, modern concrete hardscaping, artificial turf, and sweeping panoramic views—ideal for relaxing or entertaining year-round. Additional highlights include fully paid solar, a two-car garage plus a separate single-car garage, and energy-efficient living. Residents of Greer Ranch enjoy exceptional amenities, including a community pool and spa, parks, basketball courts, hiking and biking trails, community events, and 24-hour guarded security. Conveniently located near top-rated schools, shopping, dining, the 215 freeway, Murrieta’s new Costco, and just minutes from Temecula Wine Country and Old Town Temecula, this exceptional home offers the perfect blend of luxury, privacy, and convenience.

results.remarks: Beautiful 5 bedroom and 3 bathroom, 3,948 square foot home located in a cul de sac in the gated community of Greer Ranch in the city of Murrieta. This 2005 built home sits on a 6,970 square foot lot with a 2 space garage and balcony with amazing views. As you enter the home, you will see the center hallway. To the left, it branches to the downstairs bedroom with carpet flooring and sliding door closet. Next to it is the full bath with a walk in shower. Following ahead down the hallway, there's a spacious living room with abundant natural light. As we keep walking, you will come across the formal dining room featuring a hanging light and double doors that lead to the backyard and easy access to the kitchen. The kitchen is quite spacious and connects with the family room. In the little hallway that connects the dining room to the kitchen is a pantry and cabinets for extra storage. The kitchen features granite countertops with matching cabinets and stainless steel appliances such as a double oven, microwave, dishwasher, and refrigerator, 5 burner cooktop, and a kitchen island with seating for four. The family room features a fireplace and is adjacent to a family breakfast/dining area with sliding doors that connect to the backyard. Going upstairs, to the left, there is a very spacious loft with a sliding door that grants access to the balcony and a small office area. This room could be easily converted into another bedroom. Walking down the hallway, on the right side, branches into the remaining rooms. The master bedroom is enormous and features carpet flooring, its own fireplace, a spacious balcony, and an attached master bathroom which features a walk in closet, soaking tub, walk in shower, double sink with tile countertops, and a privacy door for the toilet. Bedrooms 3, 4, and 5 are generously sized, with sliding door closets. Bedroom 3 features carpet flooring and connects to the third bathroom with double sinks and a shower tub combo, and a second bedroom that connects to another hallway that branches into bedrooms 4 and 5, both with tile flooring, and the laundry room with washer and dryer included and utility sink. The backyard is spacious and can be perfect for hosting gatherings or simply adding your vision and own personal touches! Close to freeway 215, shopping centers, entertainment, grocery stores, and more.

The main level flows effortlessly from a sunlit formal living and dining room into an updated kitchen showcasing white cabinetry, a custom backsplash, and sleek black appliances, all anchored by a nice family room with a focal fireplace. Upstairs, four privately positioned bedrooms, headlined by a spacious primary suite featuring a newly remodeled spa-like bathroom with dual vanities and a large, modern walk in shower. Then outside, a resort-style backyard retreat complete with a pool and spa, a shaded covered patio, a built-in BBQ for weekend cookouts, and a grassy side yard for pets or play. Outfitted with a money-saving solar system and designed for effortless entertaining, this home offers the ultimate Murrieta lifestyle.

results.remarks: Set within the enclave surrounding the Golf Club at Rancho California and 2 minutes from Murrieta Hot Springs, with NO HOA, this home offers an impressive combination of space, flexibility, and thoughtful upgrades. From the moment you enter, you realize this home opens to a functional and beautiful floor plan designed with both everyday living and entertaining in mind. A separate formal dining room provides a dedicated space for gatherings, while multiple bonus areas, including a downstairs bonus room or office and an upstairs loft/office area, offer plenty of options for working from home, hobbies, gaming, or additional living space. The spacious kitchen features abundant cabinetry, granite counters, a large center island, stainless appliances, and generous workspace, while multiple living areas and fireplaces add warmth and character throughout the home. The primary suite is a standout, with its own private retreat and dual-sided fireplace, two walk-in closets, and an ensuite bath featuring a jetted soaking tub, creating a true getaway within the home. Outdoor living is equally versatile. In addition to the front and rear outdoor spaces, an enclosed courtyard patio offers another private spot to relax or entertain. The backyard is ready for California living with a built-in BBQ and space to gather, dine, and enjoy the outdoors. Energy upgrades for the EV and electric-conscious buyer include solar and dual EV charging capability, including both Tesla/NACS and J1772 charging in the insulated garage.

results.remarks: Located in the highly desirable Spencer’s Crossing community, this beautifully upgraded 3,684 sq. ft. home is highlighted by a private Next Gen suite and an impressive backyard with a saltwater pool. The sellers have invested approximately $250,000 in builder and owner upgrades, creating a home filled with high-end finishes. The Next Gen suite has its own exterior entrance, bedroom with walk-in closet, living area, kitchenette with sink and refrigerator, plus a private bathroom with shower, making it ideal for extended family or guests. The main home features LVP flooring throughout, plantation shutters, upgraded baseboards, recessed lighting, ceiling fans, surround sound and outdoor speakers. The kitchen features an extended oversized island with quartz waterfall edge, custom tile backsplash, upgraded white cabinetry, GE Café appliances, six-burner gas cooktop with commercial-style hood, fireclay sink, walk-in pantry and Samsung refrigerator included. Just off the kitchen is a built-in wet bar with quartz countertop, sink, GE Monogram beverage refrigerator and ice maker. One of the home’s most impressive upgrades is the three separate sets of stacking sliding glass doors that wrap the main living area, opening to the California room and backyard for a great indoor/outdoor connection. Upstairs, a very large loft/bonus room provides flexible additional living space. The spacious primary suite features mountain views, built-in display shelving, a large walk-in closet and upgraded bathroom with linen storage. Additional features include upgraded secondary bathrooms and a large laundry room with cabinetry and folding area. An LG front-loading washer and dryer are included. The home also features two whole-house fans, two A/C units and a tankless water heater. The 3-car garage includes epoxy flooring, EV charger, 220-volt outlet, holiday lighting outlets and solar. The backyard is centered around an impressive saltwater pool with a sheer-descent waterfall and stacked-stone bond beam, along with low-maintenance landscaping and coordinated patio tile. The covered California room is great for outdoor dining and entertaining. Spencer’s Crossing residents enjoy multiple pools, spa, clubhouse, parks, playgrounds, dog park, walking trails, sports fields, basketball courts, BBQ areas and more. With its private Next Gen suite, impressive pool and extensive upgrades, this home has so much to offer in one of Murrieta’s most popular communities.

results.remarks: Location does matter and this home has it! This beautiful meticulously maintained West Murrieta single-story home is on a 10,890 sq. ft. corner lot with a tandam 3-car garage. Offering 3 bedrooms and 3 full baths, this home provides comfortable, well-designed living space for all. Rich dark wood laminate flooring flows throughout, complemented by gorgeous light colored granite countertops in kitchen and baths, arched doorways, and elegant plaster crown molding—creating a seamless blend of beauty and practicality. The newly renovated kitchen is both inviting and functional, featuring a brand-new gas range, sink, microwave, cabinets and hardware, plus a walk-in pantry, center island, and additional dining space. The adjacent family room offers a perfect place to unwind, showcasing a stunning built-in hardwood media cabinet and a beautifully detailed gas fireplace with matching mantle and dark granite accents. Enjoy a designated laundry room off the hallway with extra cabinetry and a solar tube light to light your way. All three bedrooms include upgraded closet organizers and convenient access to nearby upgraded full baths. The primary suite is a true retreat, complete with a soaking tub, new separate shower, dual sinks, and an expansive walk-in closet with additional cabinetry for easy storage. Oversized sliding glass doors provide direct access to the backyard, enhancing indoor-outdoor living. Step outside to enjoy a thoughtfully designed yard featuring a covered Aluma wood patio and low-maintenance turf area. Mow curbs and French drains have been installed throughout the front and back for ease of upkeep, along with a durable Gorilla brand storage shed for added convenience. Surround yourself in beautiful landscaping with a spacious lot offering plenty of room to add a pool, create garden spaces, or even build an ADU—all surrounded by low-maintenance vinyl and block fencing. Every interior detail has been professionally maintained, reflecting true pride of ownership. Ideally located in the beautiful city of Murrieta, this home offers easy walking distance to award winning schools, parks, shopping and restaurants just around the corner. This home truly checks all the boxes—don’t miss your opportunity to make it yours!

results.remarks:
Welcome to 23993 Via Madrid, a beautifully renovated single-story home in one of Murrieta’s most desirable neighborhoods. This move-in-ready residence offers 4 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, and exceptional craftsmanship throughout, with thoughtful upgrades and quality finishes that reflect true pride of ownership.

The stunning remodeled kitchen features quartz countertops, refinished cabinetry, an expanded island, and newer appliances, making it a standout space for cooking, entertaining, and everyday living. The updated bathrooms showcase custom tile work, quartz surfaces, and a luxurious primary suite with a glass-enclosed shower.

Additional highlights include rich engineered hardwood flooring, designer tile, custom closet organizers, elegant trim details, updated lighting, and an epoxy-coated garage floor. The smooth stucco exterior, natural rock accents, and epoxy-finished driveway add to the home’s impressive curb appeal.

Step outside to a private backyard retreat with an oversized custom BBQ island, a spectacular natural rock waterfall, mature landscaping, and a beautifully crafted covered patio designed for year-round outdoor entertaining. results.remarks:
This immaculate, move-in-ready residence combines thoughtful design, premium upgrades, and outstanding flexibility for today's lifestyle. From the moment you arrive, you will appreciate the freshly painted exterior, beautifully manicured landscaping, and inviting curb appeal. The private backyard features a gazebo and serves as the perfect setting for relaxing or entertaining. 
One of the home's standout features is the private, main-level multi-generational bedroom suite, complete with a sitting area, walk-in closet, kitchenette, and full bath—ideal for extended family, guests, live-in caregivers, or independent young adults seeking their own private space. Inside, plantation shutters throughout and durable, low-maintenance tile flooring provide timeless style and easy living. The flexible floor plan offers a private office and a formal dining room, separated by an attractive wood-finished barn door for added privacy. The open-concept great room seamlessly connects to the fully equipped kitchen, making this home as functional as it is beautiful. Upstairs you'll find a generous family/media room, an oversized laundry room, an elegant primary suite along with a walk in closet and a  master bathroom which includes a shower, a relaxing soaker tub and dual vanities. There are three additional bedrooms-including one with its own private full bath-and a double-vanity hall bathroom serving the remaining two bedrooms. The two car garage is equipped with a 220-volt outlet, making it ideal for electric vehicle charging or workshop use. Adding to long-term value is a fully paid solar energy system, offering increased energy efficiency and no lease or loan to assume.  Located in the highly sought-after Spencer Crossing community, residents enjoy resort-style amenities including a sports park, junior Olympic swimming tool, spa , clubhouse and beautifully maintained common areas.  This home presents an exciting opportunity as it is back on the market due to buyer being unable to perform. It has VA appraisal well above asking price and Sellers are ready to move quickly if necessary.

results.remarks:
LOCATION, LOCATION, LOCATION! Welcome to this exceptional cul-de-sac home in highly desirable West Murrieta, ideally situated near top-rated schools, shopping, dining, and convenient I-15 access. This beautifully maintained home offers 4 bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, a downstairs bedroom and full bath, plus a versatile bonus room/office. With low taxes and no HOA, this property offers the perfect combination of location, flexibility, and value. The inviting interior features an open and functional floor plan with quality upgrades throughout. The spacious kitchen offers black granite countertops, KraftMaid cabinetry, all-wood shelving, and soft-close drawers, along with a charming bistro-style dining area that is perfect for casual meals or entertaining. The home features two fireplaces, including one with both wood-burning and gas options, adding warmth and character to the living spaces. The middle bathroom features cultured marble, while additional improvements include fresh interior paint, brand-new carpet, a newer roof, and exterior stucco paint completed in 2021. Upstairs, a QuietCool whole-house fan provides added comfort and energy-efficient cooling.
Step outside to your own private backyard oasis. Beautiful mature landscaping surrounds an impressive koi pond with a stunning waterfall, home to approximately 30 koi fish and creating a peaceful, picturesque setting. The backyard also features two plum trees, blood orange, lemon, pomegranate, and fig trees, established grapevines, a greenhouse, and a storage shed. For those who love gardening, the dedicated garden area offers exceptional potential for growing fresh produce. The current owners have successfully grown peppers, squash, tomatoes, pumpkins, and eggplant, making this a wonderful space for gardening enthusiasts and anyone who appreciates fresh, homegrown harvests.
Located in one of Murrieta's most desirable areas and tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac, this home offers an exceptional lifestyle with space, functionality, beautiful outdoor amenities, low taxes, no HOA, and an unbeatable West Murrieta location. Don't miss this opportunity to make this special property your new home!

results.remarks: Professional Pictures and 3D - Take a look. A true single-story in Spencer's Crossing, built in 2021, on a corner lot with no neighbor on one side. 2,806 square feet, 4 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, plus an office and a 3-car tandem garage with epoxy floors on an 8,712-square-foot lot. New enough that everything is current, lived-in enough to know it all works. The kitchen runs on a full Samsung Cafe suite: a five-burner gas range with griddle, convection oven, counter-depth refrigerator, and a hood venting outside, set against granite counters, a walk-in pantry, and soft-close cabinetry. A built-in nook off the pantry takes a desk or extra storage. The primary suite sits on the opposite end of the house from the other three bedrooms, with dual sinks, a rainfall shower, pre-plumbing for a soaking tub, and a walk-in closet fitted with built-ins. One of the rooms closes behind its own door, so a home office is an office. The systems are the part you feel later. Frontier fiber internet with Ethernet drops in every major room, EV pre-wire in the garage, a Rinnai tankless water heater on gas, dual-pane windows and LED lighting throughout, a Honeywell Wi-Fi thermostat, and fire-suppression sprinklers in the entire home. A Puronics whole-house softener and filtration feeds the taps, an alkaline drinking-water system in the kitchen, and even a filtered exterior hose bib so you can wash a car without water spots. The home carries SunPower solar and a Vivint security system with four exterior cameras and door sensors. Out back is finished, not a promise. A center slider opens from the dining area to a covered patio and a concrete pad built for cookouts, with fenced grass, two 4-by-10 redwood raised garden beds on their own irrigation, and a six-zone Hunter system covering the yard. The concrete-tile roof is the kind that outlasts the mortgage. Spencer's Crossing brings the pools, clubhouse, fitness center, sport and pickleball courts, playgrounds, and trails. Harvest Hill STEAM Academy sits about a mile away, and the I-215 puts Temecula ten minutes south with a straight line toward South OC. Some images are virtually staged.

results.remarks: Welcome to 30536 Astoria Lane in the desirable Spencer’s Crossing community of Murrieta. This spacious 5-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom home offers an ideal blend of comfort, functionality, and style. Downstairs features a versatile flex room with a walk-in closet, perfect for a home office or potential fifth bedroom (with closet), along with wood laminate flooring throughout and extra storage under the stairs. The open-concept layout includes a formal dining room, a convenient half bath with pedestal sink, and an office nook off the living room. The kitchen is equipped with granite countertops, a large island, stainless steel appliances—including a gas oven, overhead microwave, dishwasher, and refrigerator—plus a walk-in pantry and a built-in coffee bar. Upstairs you’ll find four additional bedrooms, making a total of five rooms, as well as a large open loft and a generously sized laundry room with washer/dryer hookups, shelving, and cabinetry. Each of the three guest bedrooms includes a walk-in closet, and the guest bathroom features dual sinks and a full tub/shower combo. The luxurious primary suite offers a private retreat with an oversized soaking tub, separate walk-in shower, dual vanities with an expansive mirror, a private toilet room, and a massive walk-in closet. Exterior highlights include a mix of brick and vinyl fencing, a concrete patio in the backyard, and a small retaining wall garden surrounding the yard with no direct rear neighbors and peekaboo mountain views. The front yard is beautifully landscaped and features a roll-up garage door, tile roof, and stucco finish. Located in the sought-after Spencer’s Crossing neighborhood, residents enjoy access to multiple sports parks, walking trails, and playgrounds, making this home an exceptional opportunity in one of Murrieta’s premier communities.

Welcome to this beautifully remodeled single-level home in the highly sought-after Spencer’s Crossing community of Murrieta. Situated on a desirable corner lot on a cul-de-sac street, this light and bright four-bedroom, two-bath residence offers an exceptional combination of thoughtful design, modern upgrades, and resort-style community amenities.

Completely remodeled just two years ago, the home showcases an extensive list of upgrades, including a brand-new kitchen featuring a GE Café suite of appliances, brand new enlarged center island, quartz countertops, marble backsplash, soft close doors and drawers, generous cabinetry and beautiful hardware, new wood flooring, fresh interior and exterior paint, new baseboards, upgraded light fixtures, new ceiling fans, virtually every surface has been upgraded and remodeled.

With its highly desirable corner cul-de-sac location, single-level floor plan, extensive recent remodeling, and access to one of Murrieta’s most desirable master-planned communities, this move-in ready home offers a lifestyle as exceptional as the home itself.
